paragraphs.text: Review the Rhythm Behind Continuous Progress.
Move between today's work, authorized progression since your last review, weekly review, monthly patterns, and history.
Review the current priority, next action, and anything that needs to carry into the day.
See what progressed, what stalled, what repeated, what was overridden, and what requires a change in capability or execution.
Step back from individual tasks to review patterns, outcomes, capability changes, and strategic movement.
